title: Arthur742Ramos/SpinorLean
abstract: Formalizes an exterior-model spinor construction for a field K in which 2 is invertible, using an explicit hyperbolic presentation and the Clifford conjugation action on the ambient quadratic space.  The development proves field-sensitive covering and image results: the positive split-rank spin-to-isometry kernel is {1,-1}, the spin action therefore descends only projectively, the split-line image is exactly the square-scaling subgroup, and a finite-dimensional split Levi element associated to g lies in the ambient spin image exactly when det(g) is a square unit.  The repository also packages the chosen exterior model, half-spin pieces, explicit transvection and square-scaling Clifford lifts, square-class quotient characters, vector-product norm identities, and selected complex and real low-dimensional Clifford classifications.
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
